Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset: production background plate for an existing Korean astrology animal character, landscape 3:2 (1536x1024).
Input images: existing animal artwork is a MATERIAL AND LIGHTING STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. Do not include, redraw, or reinterpret the animal.
Art direction: a sophisticated miniature storybook environment that belongs to the SAME world as the reference's soft rounded white 3D mascot. Soft milky, slightly translucent toy-like surfaces, restrained pastel color, smooth broad shapes, beautiful diffuse light, subtle ambient occlusion, refined animation-film set design. NOT shiny porcelain, not jewelry, not ornate gold filigree, not photoreal botanicals.
Composition: fill the ENTIRE rectangular canvas with a real continuous illustrated environment: sky, subtle distant scenery, an unobstructed gently curved ground plane. All edges are fully opaque. Focal area at center is calm and bright; a separate animal will occupy x=27%-73%, y=18%-86%. Reserve this whole area from foreground objects. Place scenery mostly at the outer 20% and in the far distance. Ground contact baseline for animal at y=86%, soft diffuse lighting consistent with upper-left illumination. Natural scene depth, NOT two isolated symmetrical props, not a framed vignette, not a round badge, no giant disk behind animal, no pedestal.
Typography: none. No words, logo, watermark, animal, person, face, or character.
Palette / environment: WOOD / spring celadon. A tranquil soft mint and sage grove with broad rounded, softly blurred tree canopies in the upper corners and far background, a few low velvety meadow plants at the outer bottom edges, a pale mint-ivory gently curved clearing across the foreground. Sophisticated pale celadon atmosphere, soft blue-green distant hills, warm luminous cream at center. Quiet spacious forest clearing, beautifully art-directed shape design; fine detail only at the edges. Bottom edge is a smooth pale mint ground, approximately #E7F1EA.
